The dollar figure describes infrastructure value, not the attack's operating cost, company revenue or incident-response spending.
The named owners and claimed scale must be connected to resources enabling this incident. Industry-wide spending alone cannot establish that connection.
Dollars is read as US dollars. No valuation or accounting basis is supplied.
The wording leaves unclear whether the value refers to entire provider fleets or the resources allocated to the attack.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable incident records disprove the infrastructure scale or ownership attribution, or controlled comparisons establish the opposite causal ordering.
